Estate planning starts with a simple question: who should know what to do if you cannot speak for yourself?

A clear plan can help families find documents, understand wishes, and avoid guessing in a difficult moment. This is education, not legal advice.

Schedule a Planning Conversation: https://jmerrill.financial/

Advanced planning is not only about assets. It is about the people who may have to make decisions when timing is hard.

The right conversation can connect family priorities, documents, insurance considerations, and next steps before pressure arrives. No guarantees or legal advice.

Start a Planning Conversation: https://jmerrill.financial/

Funeral and pre-need planning can be an act of care for the people who will have to make choices later.

Some options may involve insurance products, so the conversation should stay clear, practical, and matched to the family's needs. No legal, tax, or investment advice.

Ask About Advanced Planning: https://jmerrill.financial/
